method: BASELINE. scope: From the seat of the business owner (Daniel's company Jarrah Legal Technologies Pty Ltd; sole traders, partners, trusts). What a business is (s 4, tied to ABN entitlement) and carrying on, including start-up (s 3); must I register the name, the s 18(2) exceptions (own name for individuals, corporations and partnerships only; notified registers; statutory names; government bodies; notified successors; prescribed circumstances), the 3-month consent window (s 31(6)) and the review period after cancellation (s 54(1)(b)); the s 18 offence and the penalties for ss 18-21, with five times for a body corporate (Crimes Act s 4B(3)); what business documents must show (s 19); availability of a name (s 25, with ss 27(2), 28(2A), 31(3)); disqualification (s 32); when ASIC must register (s 24), applying while an ABN is pending (ss 23(2)(a)(ii), 29(2)); the unpaid fee (s 30) and 28 days' silence (s 34(2), (5)); 1- or 3-year registration and alternative periods (s 33(2)-(5)); renewal no earlier than 2 months before expiry (s 55(1), (8)); expiry and cancellation (s 49(3)-(5)); notifying changes (s 35); cancellation for non-use (s 47). Not encoded: the s 20 display duty and s 21 beyond their penalties, the application's other contents, ss 42-46, 48, 50-53, the register and access (ss 22, 60-62), review (Part 7), Part 10, the Transitional Act, the Fees Act amounts, the Minister's instruments on identical, undesirable and restricted names (not deposited; asked as facts), machinery.
seat: the business owner: the entity carrying on a business under a name (for Daniel, his company Jarrah Legal Technologies Pty Ltd)
